Jensen Huang RTX Spark N1X reinvented PC Microsoft

hook: Game Over! NVIDIA has just declared the traditional computer dead, bringing *40 years of PC architecture* to an end
caption:
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has unveiled what he believes could be the biggest change to personal computers in decades.
At GTC Taipei, NVIDIA introduced RTX Spark, powered by its new N1X chip developed with MediaTek. It combines a 20-core Grace CPU, Blackwell RTX GPU, and up to 128GB of shared memory, delivering up to 1 petaflop of AI performance.
The shift is already reaching consumers. Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra launched on October 16, becoming one of the first laptops powered by NVIDIA's new chip.
For decades, PCs have relied on separate processors, graphics cards, and memory. NVIDIA now wants to rethink that design, bringing powerful AI directly onto computers so they can run advanced models and AI agents without relying on the cloud.
